scenario: LSER.19.8 — `count` keeps a concrete type and a cold `count` is `0`. Same shape as LSER.19.8_cold_mean_does_not_fire (one assert, one pump, single-pattern `where` evaluated at assert before any sample is absorbed), with `count(r.v) == 0` (function form: the companion `r.count` is refused today with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_SLOT while `r.mean` is accepted; routed separately). It fires. This is the positive control for the two cold-null vectors: it shows a cold series read IS evaluated in this position, so their silence is the `null` and not a read that never runs. A runtime answering `null` for every cold read — the concrete partition ignored — fails here.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Float mutable

schema Warm scope logical:
    d: Int key

series Reading.v:
    count sliding 10_min

rule cold_count:
    Reading r where count(r.v) == 0
->
    emit Warm logical d: 0
